title: Unit Event — What Lies Beyond Guiding a Lost Child

meta.Event: What Lies Beyond Guiding a Lost Child
meta.Outline: With university practice exams looming, Mafuyu continues to study to meet her mother's expectations. Meanwhile, Mizuki suggests a trip to an amusement park for N25.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The pace of that cram school class was so much faster than usual today...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Probably because we're taking a practice exam this weekend... And things likely felt a little different because everyone's making their final preparations.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I have to get a good score on this practice exam...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Welcome home, Mafuyu.
I take it cram school went well? Are you ready for that practice exam?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, I should be.
But I'll have to keep studying to make sure I get an A.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You did well on all those other practice exams... But this upcoming one is for specific schools.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: For the sake of your future, an A for Meio University... No, I'm sure you want that for Koto University at the very least, so I understand why you seem so motivated.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But don't push yourself too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I promise not to...
I have to keep up with the other students since they've begun making their final preparations, but I'll be mindful of my health.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. And I'm sure you'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to seeing some good results.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you, Mom.
I'll do my best.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <If we keep this up, we'll be ready to upload our new song the day after tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Awesome! I put a ton of effort into the video, so I can't wait to see everyone's responses.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hold your horses... Great work? You know we're still not done yet, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Haha. Yeah, I know...
But the quality of our songs has been going up, so I really can't wait to see what people think.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, that's understandable.
Speaking of which, we still don't have the rough draft for our next song.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm sorry. I'm going to need more time to figure out the concept for this song.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <So the rough draft is going to take a little longer than usual for me to finish...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Uh... I've been spending some of my free time here and there to come up with something, but I haven't had much luck...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Okay...
Yeah, we all hit a wall sometimes.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But we're all gonna be making small fixes to our current song through the day after tomorrow, so I feel like there's no rush.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Right. Thank you...
But I still want to finish my draft sooner rather than later...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Heh heh heh.
In that case, leave it to moi!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hold on. The way you just said that... You're not planning anything funny, are you?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Don't worry!
This trip won't be scary at all!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <This trip? So, we're going somewhere together?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yup! I'm actually in possession of one-day passes to Phoenix Wonderland!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That's right! One of the cast members that I'm friends with gave them to me and said that I should visit with everyone in my group!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I know, right♪
He builds life-size robots and stuff for his shows... And sometimes performs explosive experiments at school...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Haha. That's because he always goes all out for his shows!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, why don't we all go to PXL together since I have some tickets?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, but they're for a specific date, so we can only go this Sunday...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'm all for that. Everyone's been talking about how great the night show is online, so I've been meaning to see it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, that's all the more reason for us to go! And it'll be a nice way for us to relax!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yes...
I'm not a fan of crowded places, but I'll go if it can help me compose more songs...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, why not go?
It probably won't be like the mystery tour we went on, but I'm sure you'll find some nice inspiration.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And you'll have plenty of chances to take some good selfies during the night show, Enanan♪>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Going to an amusement park with everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <So, Yuki, how about you? Can you go?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to seeing some good results.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I can't. I have to take a practice exam that day...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, a practice exam...?
That's too bad.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Then, PXL's just nearby.
Wanna meet up once you're done?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah!
We should try to go together since we can!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Okay, maybe just for a bit after I finish taking my practice exam...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<...!
Sorry, I need to mute myself for a second.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, I was watching a movie.
I thought I could work on my English listening skills if I turned the subtitles off.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Ah, that explains why your computer's on. But you don't have to watch it in darkness like this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I thought that it'd be bothersome if light seeped out of my room.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. You're such a good girl, Mafuyu. Staying up so late to study like this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I'm sorry for making you worry like this. I promise to go to bed soon.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Understood.
In that case, good night.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It was my mom telling me to go to bed soon. Anyway, about what we were talking about...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I can't go.
I have to see how I did on the practice exam by checking each question after I finish taking it, so you all go without me.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Okay...
I guess there isn't much we can do about that.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But we can always go back on a day when you're not scheduled to take a practice exam!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, you really should take more time to relax, so don't forget to tell us the next time you're free, okay...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Try not to work too hard, Yuki...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <My mom might come back to check in on me again, so I'll be logging off for now...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Bye, Mom.
I'm off to school.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Good luck.
Oh, you don't have cram school today, so will you be coming home early?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, so I'm planning on staying at school to study. I'll be home at my usual time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Just as motivated today, I see.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But try not to get too focused on studying and forget to come home before curfew, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you, Mom.
I should get going now!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, I know. I should take this chance to clean her room...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: A clean environment will make it easier for her to study...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hmm... That math study guide should be...

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Hm? Mafuyu, aren't you gonna go home? Your club's taking a break today, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, but I'd like to get in some studying before going home since I have a practice exam coming up.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: You're such a straight arrow, Mafuyu. You know it's important to take breaks from time to time, right?

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: But at the same time, you're really smart, so I guess there's nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Oh, but I need to get to club soon. Bye bye, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I've done three passes of the problem sets for the practice exam, so I'm probably ready now...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I should get the results I want since I've done the work...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
And I should head home soon.
Mom's probably waiting for me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Mom, is something the matter?
Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Um, Mafuyu...
Is there anything you're hiding from me?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
What...? No, nothing.
Why would I hide anything from you, Mom...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Can you say that while looking straight into my eyes?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Am I hiding anything...?
What can't I tell her about...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, I'm not hiding anything from you. Again, Mom, why would I ever do that...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Then, what is the meaning of this?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I found it while cleaning your room just now. You have no use for it, so it's only going to get in the way, no?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: It must be because your father just let it gather dust after buying it. Anyway, I'm thinking about having it taken away tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Why? Because you don't need it, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Ah, you must be the removers.
I've gathered everything out front, so if you don't mind hauling it away for us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: There's no need for you to stay and watch, Mafuyu. Also, isn't it about time you headed off to cram school?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Anyway, I need to go pass this circular on to our neighbors.

rows.Speaker: Junk Remover
rows.Line: Phew... That just leaves this synthesizer.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry...
This got mixed in with the junk somehow. We can still use this synthesizer, so you don't need to take it away.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll be sure to let my mother know.

rows.Speaker: Junk Remover
rows.Line:
Okay, understood.
Then, we'll haul the other things away.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
I thought we'd gotten rid of this.
What was it doing in your room, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I was thinking that I could invest in my future by learning more about it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: One of my friends knows how to play music and I gained some interest after seeing what she can do, so I decided to study music a little.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You've heard of music therapy, right? I thought it might help me in the future...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
I'm so proud of you, Mafuyu.
You're taking the initiative by trying to learn new things.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you, Mom, so this synthesizer...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Is this really all that necessary right now?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, music is indeed a wonderful thing and music therapy may prove to serve you well when you do become a doctor.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm worried that music will get in the way of your studies and even lead to less-than-ideal results by the time entrance exams roll around.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Of course, you're smart, and a good girl above all else, so I'm sure you'll do just fine...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But I can't help but wonder if this is going to end up limiting the choices that are available to you in the future.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm sure you can learn all about music therapy in medical school... And if you wish to relax, I'm sure there are many other ways...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, why don't you watch more movies like you did last night? Didn't you say you want to improve your listening skills by turning the subtitles off?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'll ask this teacher I know about any movies that they think will help with that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you, Mom...
I'm sorry for making you worry so much...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And nothing's going to change moving forward...?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I have to keep wandering in the dark not knowing what I want or what's supposed to be fun?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Even when I become a high schooler, go to university and beyond...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I want to know why this song has such a hold over me...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll start by copying the melody...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm glad to see that you're so worried about me, Mom...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I want to try my hand at music...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Of course, I promise not to let it get in the way of my studies and will try not to be too much of a burden on my friend...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Is this friend of yours the same age as you...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: That's so marvelous, Mafuyu. I understand why you're so interested in the arts since they can do wonders for your mind.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But is this friend in the process of getting ready for entrance exams...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: If this friend of yours was actually studying for exams and aiming for high-level goals like you, Mafuyu, then I'd be more than happy to let you take this on as a nice, relaxing hobby...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Mafuyu, I know it's important to be exposed to different kinds of people, but networking with the right people is just as important.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: So, what you need right now are peers who are studying just as hard as you for entrance exams. Am I wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You surely stand to benefit much more from having friends who are trying to achieve the same kinds of goals as you, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
What's gotten into you today?
Did I do something that wasn't to your liking...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: All I'm trying to do is make sure you have the best future possible...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry...
I didn't mean to step on your toes...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I know you're always putting serious thought into my future, so I apologize for making you worry so much...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
If there's something you truly wish to do, I plan on being there to support you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm worried about you, so I can't help but state how I feel... However, Mafuyu, it's ultimately your life to live...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: So you're free to do whatever you like...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: If you truly wish to do something, Mafuyu, you're free to do it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Just don't regret your decision, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And I'll use that time to prepare for exams, so you don't have to worry so much about me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, since my studies come first.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: That means you don't need this synthesizer anymore, right? I'll hold onto it for now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, okay.
I'm sorry for saying what I did.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll be in my room studying until it's time for dinner...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(My chest... It feels so... cold...
And painful... My mind feels so overwhelmed...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (The way Mom said that remark... I can't get it out of my head...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Just don't regret your decision, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Can you come over to SEKAI?
There's something I wanna tell everyone!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (My head... I'm having trouble focusing... But I need to find the others...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Hm? What's going on...?
They're acting a little different than usual...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It's okay.
Don't be scared... Let's be friends!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You know that's just gonna scare him more, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Well, you may just want to see for yourself.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
So...
Do you think you can say hello?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... He really doesn't want to come out from behind Miku...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Maybe he's shy... Or just embarrassed...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A mix of both from what I can tell.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, exactly!
I came over to SEKAI to take a break from what I was doing and saw Len here!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I felt like I had to tell all of you immediately, so I sent out messages in a hurry.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, you could've just told us that instead of saying, “There's something I need to tell everyone.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it's nice to see more faces in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I agree...
But Len still doesn't seem very comfortable here...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I spoke with him a little before you all came here, but he's still a bit nervous it seems...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And yet, he's sticking close to you, Miku...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Probably because Miku's the one who found him and brought him over to where we were...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Don't be afraid to open up to us a little more, okay?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? He seems quite afraid of you too, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Now you're just putting words in his mouth...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha...
Let's get to know Len by taking it slow.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Just don't regret your decision, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What's wrong...?
You look like you're in pain.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You know we're all worried because your face says otherwise, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why don't you just tell us in your own words?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I have to keep studying for it, but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Slow down. Don't jump ahead like that. Why is it a bad thing that Mafuyu's mom found her synthesizer...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, it's not that it's a bad thing, but it could get kinda ugly...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hang on...
Have you not told her about us making music?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No...
Because I think all she wants me to do is study.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She even tried to get rid of the synthesizer in my room once already...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're kidding, right? Who goes that far to make their kid study?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Luckily, I was able to save it from the junk removers that time...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But you said your mom found it back in your room. Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She said she's going to hold onto it, which probably means she's going to toss it at some point...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's horrible. She's taking your stuff away even though you haven't done anything wrong...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Um, Mafuyu, mind telling us a little more about your mom...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I doubt you'll find it all that interesting...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, there's that.
And I get that talking to someone else about your own family isn't easy.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, you don't have to tell us if you don't want to.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: All I'm saying is that if it'll take a load off your mind, we'd be more than happy to hear what you have to say.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hear what I have to say...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, Mafuyu, what's your mom like...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A normal person doesn't try to throw away someone else's stuff without asking them first.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You mentioned how she tried to get rid of your synthesizer before. Didn't that bother you at all?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But she's always talking about how it's for the sake of my future...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Instead of spending my time on music, I should be doing things that will help me with entrance exams... Because that's what is best for me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So... I have to... Give up music...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But you need it, right?
Which means you have to tell your parents.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You don't have to just keep quiet and do what they tell you to do...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Because I believe what my mom says about me is all true...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's exactly what I mean by you doing as you're told...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena, I get that you're worried about Mafuyu, but let's take a step back for a minute.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Despite all of this, Mafuyu cares a lot about her mom...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, I understand that part but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But do you really think everything she says is right, Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But you wouldn't have come here if some part of you thought she wasn't right, don't you think...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, your mom's saying that you should be studying instead of messing around with music, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If you really thought she was right, you'd be holed up in your room right now studying for whatever.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And I'll use that time to prepare for exams, so you don't have to worry so much about me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know what to do...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, let's all just take a deep breath! And Mafuyu seems pretty exhausted, so why don't we talk about this another time?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I know! We should throw Len a welcoming party and give him a chance to get to know everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, but this is really sudden...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. That sounds nice.
Will you be joining us, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I don't mind welcoming him, but I'll leave the merrymaking to the rest of you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sure. I mean, there's no reason not to...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I can't until I finish taking my practice exam...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Sorry...
I should head back for the night.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I know I'm not in a position to be saying this...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I understand just how much your mom means to you... But I also don't want you to be too hard on yourself.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because I don't like seeing you in pain, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I really think you should just do what you want to do. You don't have to listen to absolutely everything your parents say!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So it's totally okay for you to go and visit PXL if you get tired of studying!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Isn't there anything we can do to help Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I get how you feel, Kanade, but I feel like you're already giving her a ton of support.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. I mean, you're composing music just for her.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: At the same time, I understand your concern...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Since you're just as worried, right, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you're that worried about Mafuyu, why don't you all try working on a song together...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu seems to be most at ease whenever she's creating music with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, that might be our best option at this point...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mafuyu might not know it herself, but what we do definitely means a lot to her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which means we should visit PXL as soon as we can to give Kanade a chance to have fun and come up with song ideas!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: My original plan was for the four of us to go together, but I'd rather not force anything on anyone...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But it should still be worth the trip if it means helping Mafuyu, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much.
For Mafuyu's sake, I promise to finish my rough draft as soon as possible.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Is she going to be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But do you really think everything she says is right, Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But you wouldn't have come here if some part of you thought she wasn't right, don't you think...?
The day of the practice exam

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, Mom, I'm off to take the practice exam...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Good luck, Mafuyu.
You won't be home much later than usual, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, I have to see how I did for each question before I can come home, so I may run a little late. I'll let you know when I start heading back.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Understood. I'll be wishing you the best, so please get there safe.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The exam's taking place... I think over there...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's not actually that far from the station, but it's taking me so long to get there.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I have to get an A...
Mom's counting on me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Why...? I just want her to be happy...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to seeing some good results.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But you wouldn't have come here if some part of you thought she wasn't right, don't you think...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
<Are you at the testing center now?
Good luck with the practice exam.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <I'll be looking forward to hearing good news.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This is awful... My insides feel like they're getting all twisted up... I'm having trouble breathing...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But I have to get there soon...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If I don't take this exam, she'll...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: If you truly wish to do something, Mafuyu, you're free to do it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Just don't regret your decision, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Heya! Mafuyu, you about to take that practice exam? The rest of us just met up at PXL!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I know you said you won't be able to make it, but you're welcome to join us if you finish scoring yourself and stuff early!>

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Please enjoy your visit to Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If I go back now, I can still make it in time...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <The last time you visited SEKAI, you looked like you were in pain.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <And Len wanted to see how you were doing.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hm? Miku? Len...?
I didn't realize you two were also here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, Mafuyu, what about your practice exam? Was there a last-minute schedule change or something?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If that's the case, you should've let us know that you were coming. Oh, who am I kidding...? At least we ran into you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hang on. Are you skipping it?
No, that's not something you'd do either...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we go for a little walk...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We don't really know what's going on and you don't have to tell us if you don't feel up to it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But since we're here...
I know it might be hard to get in the mood to have fun, so let's at least try to enjoy the scenery and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And you're free to leave whenever you like. We won't stop you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, that settles that!
Let's go, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This is your guys' first time at PXL too, right, Miku? Wanna check it out with us?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
So many people.
I don't remember having to do so much maneuvering the last time I was here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You can probably thank the night show for going viral online. They've been traveling to do shows as ambassadors too, so more people from further away have apparently been visiting the park.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
You seem to know a lot about this, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, I'm friends with someone from the cast. He even directed the original night show, so I kinda want all of us to see it if we have the time...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(What's Mom going to say...
After supporting me so much too.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Maybe if I go back now, I can still...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry, Miku, you guys gotta hide!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I-Is everything okay?
You seem even less cheerful than you usually... No, wait! I mean, something seems different...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, it's okay. I'm just fine...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But what are the odds of us meeting here like this? Are you here to enjoy the park as well?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm actually about to do a show!
I'm one of the cast members here!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...
I'm sorry. I remember you mentioning that now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, that's fine!
Are you here with your friends today, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're a cast member...?
Does that mean you're gonna be in the night show?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yes!
We'll be doing a show at the Wonder Stage before the night show too, so please come and watch if you can!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks! We were just talking about seeing it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe...!
I'll do my best to make you all feel really wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Asahina...!
I hope you enjoy your visit to Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because this is a place that makes everyone smile!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Bye bye! Good luck during the show!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A place that makes everyone smile...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Is she one of your juniors from school, Mafuyu? She seems really cheerful.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But she seemed really scared of you, Mafuyu.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Even though you're really not scary at all...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, she was plenty scary just now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But you couldn't really help it. Especially today. Anyway, we're here to relax and have fun, so try not to push yourself too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Are you sure you're okay, Mafuyu?
If you don't feel well, we can take a little break...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm okay, really.
I'll even go on whatever rides you want.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Really?!
I had something in mind just in case you said that! Let's go, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, they're a park's attractions, and it's fun to go on them as a group.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And the one I wanna go on is... The Phoenix Coaster!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Isn't that a pretty intense roller coaster? Are you sure you don't wanna choose something more kid-friendly since Len and the others are with us?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You say that... But you're really the one that's scared, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Nah, I'm sure you'll be fine...
But it might be safer to try something more kid-friendly before going on the faster one!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Mafuyu, have you ever been here before?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, it's just... I can't see the current you visiting Phoenix Wonderland is all...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I came here once with my mom when I was little...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What was it like when I came here with her...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Here we are!
Alright, let's give it a go!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whew! That was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I had fun too...!
Whizzing around on those rides was so amazing.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I agree. I was a bit startled, but we also got to see some beautiful sights.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm glad you guys liked it, but I could really go for a quick break now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm going to get something to drink...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I ended up staying this long...
There's no point in going now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I don't know...
I don't even understand why I came here.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Honestly, why did I come here...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Would you rather be taking that practice exam instead of being here with everyone else...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I know that the practice exam is more important and that Mom wanted me to do well on it...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Mafuyu, I'm not seeing Kanade or the others.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Which direction did I come from...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh no. D-Does this mean we're lost...?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Calm down, Len.
But... What do we do...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I can use my phone to let Kanade and the others know...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Okay, I got a hold of them...
They said to wait and stay put.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Thank goodness...
We should be fine now, Len.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Let's find a place that's easy to find and wait for them there...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Aren't you scared of being all alone like this...?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<O-Okay...
That's amazing... I'm actually a little scared...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Why are you so scared, Len...?
You're not actually alone right now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I keep going back to when I arrived in SEKAI for the first time...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Yeah... It was so big and empty...
And I was lost until Miku found me.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Just the thought of that still petrifies me a bit...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That reminds me. When I was little...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Mafuyu, this amusement park's very crowded, so you need to promise not to stray too far from me.

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Okay!
Thank you for bringing me here, Mommy!

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Everything's so sparkly...!
And everyone's smiling like they're really having fun!)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, Mafuyu, look.
The churros from that shop are supposed to be very good. Shall we go try it out?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
There's quite a line...
Would you be okay with us waiting a little?

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
That's okay!
This park's so sparkly that I'm having fun just looking at everything!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're such a good girl, Mafuyu.
But you still need to promise to stay by my side.

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What should we go on after we get our churros...? The merry-go-round's really cute, but the fish coaster also looks fun.)

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Phenny's supposed to go for walks sometimes around the park too.)

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's Phenny! Oh, I wanna shake hands with him...!)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Here's your churro, Mafuyu.
Is plain okay?

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, plain's okay!
Also, Mommy, I just saw Phenny over there...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Just a minute.
Your father's calling me. What could this be about?

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Oh no... Phenny's about to leave... If I don't go now, I might not get to shake hands with him...)

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But I have to stay close to Mommy...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Mafuyu. In a minute.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, you'll be done with work early?
That means I'll need to start preparing dinner soon.

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But Phenny's right there, so maybe if I go for just a little bit...)

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I got to shake hands with Phenny...
Now I need to get back to where Mommy is!)

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Mommy was just right here...
Where'd she go?

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Wh-What do I do...?
I'm lost... I have to find Mommy...

rows.Speaker: Female Passerby
rows.Line:
Oh, what's wrong?
Did you get separated from your mommy and daddy?

rows.Speaker: Female Passerby
rows.Line:
You seem lost...
Can you tell me your name?

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Wait, Mommy said that I'm not supposed to talk to any strangers...)

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Some strangers tried to talk to me... And everyone else is staring at me...)

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Was the merry-go-round always that big...? The horsies looked so much cuter before...)

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(The park stopped being sparkly too...
What's going on...?)

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I'm scared... I'm so scared...
Mommy... Where are you...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Mafuyu!
Thank goodness! I looked all over for you...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
I was worried sick about you.
But I'm so glad I found you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Are you okay, Mafuyu?
Are you hurt at all?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
You being safe is all that matters.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: However, Mafuyu, can I ask you one question?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Why did you break our promise?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Didn't you say that you wouldn't leave my side? So why did you decide to run off like that?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You disappearing like that absolutely terrified me, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I was afraid that you'd become a “bad girl” that gives her mother grief...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, Mafuyu. The thought of you vanishing from right out under me made me so sad...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: It made my heart sink... And made me so fearful...

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry, Mommy...!
Please, don't cry... I... I...

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't want to see you cry...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But I'd feel so much better if I knew that you'd be a “good girl” who listens to what her mother says...

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry...
I promise to be a good girl...!
I promise to listen to what you say...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's okay.
I feel much better now that I know you're going to be a good girl for me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's head home for the day.
I need to start preparing dinner so that your father can come home at any time.

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
M-Mommy...
That hurts... Please, don't pull...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My mom's hand felt so cold that time...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, not just then...
Even now... She feels so cold...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <O-Oh no...! We have to help her...!>

rows.Speaker: Girl's Mother
rows.Line:
There you are!
Thank goodness... Are you hurt?

rows.Speaker: Girl's Mother
rows.Line: You must've been so scared, but you're safe now. Let's hold hands so you don't get lost again.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Y-Yeah. Her heart must've felt so cold when she was all alone...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Len, you know what that feels like...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I was like her too...
When I arrived in SEKAI, there was no one but me...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I tried looking for everyone, but I couldn't find any of them...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<But then, Miku found me...
And felt so warm when she took my hand.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Because it felt like she was saying, “You're not alone”...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <So I thought that little girl must've felt the same way.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I think I've felt the warmth he's talking about before...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thank goodness we found you, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Seriously, we searched all over for you! It's amazing just how much of a handful you always are...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And just saying, “I think I'm lost,” isn't exactly the best way to tell someone where you are, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I'm glad we found you so quick!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me too. We're back together now and it's a relief to see that you're safe.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Honestly, she isn't a little kid, so there probably was no need to worry so much about her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sorry for leaving you all alone like that, Mafuyu. It must've been very uncomfortable for you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I felt so cold just a second ago...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is it me or are there more people here now...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, probably because the night show's gonna start soon. Everyone's probably moving somewhere they can see it, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's about that time already.
Let's make sure not to get separated again...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah... Hold on, Mafuyu!
You're gonna run into someone if you keep spacing out like that!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Are you okay? Did you get hurt anywhere?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, I just grazed them a little...
But...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
I thought you were about to fall, so I reacted by grabbing yours...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Kanade's hand... It feels a bit cold...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But warm at the same time... Why is that...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(And it isn't just her.
Ena, Mizuki, everyone... Whatever they're giving me feels... Nice...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <If you feel that way, Mafuyu, then I'm happy...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <It's probably because you're here with everyone.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I mean, being with everyone makes me feel all warm inside too.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Anyway, about the night show...
Are we gonna stick around to watch it together?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I wanna see it! Oh, wait... Mafuyu, do you need to start heading home soon...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I won't make it home in time if I stay to watch the night show. I should go home...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <It's probably because you're here with everyone.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think I'll watch some of it before I go.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, that means we should get a move on! We'll need to hurry if we don't wanna get stuck watching it from really far away...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, we should find a good spot since we've come all this way.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I still don't understand what this feeling is...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What separates Mom from Kanade and the others...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Why do I feel so cold whenever I'm around Mom...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I should stop. Just thinking about it's painful...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I'll keep enjoying this “warmth” a little longer...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Your practice exam... You didn't feel well, so...?
I see... And you feel better now?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Can you make it home on your own? Do you need me to come pick you up?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, you're going to stay at a friend's house...? Understood. Please be careful on your way back.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Also, after you've returned, I'd like to hear more about this friend so that I can thank their parents later.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. It's only natural to do so since they'll be taking care of you, right, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, please let me know once you feel settled. I'll be waiting until then.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
(Did she push herself too hard...?
To be fair, she's always been a hard-working girl.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: (But it took her so long to contact me. I suppose she needed time to rest...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: One of my friends knows how to play music and I gained some interest after seeing what she can do, so I decided to study music a little.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hello. This is the mother of Mafuyu Asahina from Class 2-B. There's something I'd like to ask, so would you mind if I have a word with her teacher...?
